visual.name: bfusionFTEDecisionBoard
visual.description: An insight-rich FTE planning table with heatmap cells, sparklines, trend indicators and KPI summaries for resource allocation decisions.

dataRoles.name: rowCategory
dataRoles.description: Drag up to 3 fields for a hierarchy, outermost first — e.g. Department, then Role, then Resource.

dataRoles.name: colCategory
dataRoles.description: Bind a DATE column (e.g. DimDate[Date]) to sort periods chronologically and enable the Year/Quarter/Month/Week picker. A text column is shown in source order, with the picker disabled.

dataRoles.name: measures
dataRoles.description: Drag up to 6 measures here — e.g. FTE Demand, Capacity, Scheduled, Timesheet. Comparisons are configured under Format > Comparisons.

dataRoles.name: licenseToken
dataRoles.description: Bind to the single-cell BFusionLicense[Key] column in your model

mode.description: Surface theme for the visual chrome. Auto follows the report theme's background.

background.description: Custom mode only. Plot and root background.

surface.description: Custom mode only. Header, toolbar, panels, tiles and tooltips.

textColor.description: Custom mode only. Primary text colour.

mutedColor.description: Custom mode only. Labels, captions and axis text.

ruleColor.description: Custom mode only. Separators, tile borders and axis lines.

aggregationRules.description: Comma-separated, one per bound measure, in field order: avg or sum. FTE and rates use avg; hours and counts use sum. Blank means avg for all.

c1Edges.description: e.g. 50/75/100/120. Blank uses the global band edges.

showInsightsPanel.description: The narrative panel beside the board. Independent of Show Insight Column, which is the per-row narrative inside the table.

colorMode.description: Ratio colours each cell by measure A divided by measure B. Absolute colours by the raw value against the FTE thresholds.

licenseKey.description: Paste your BFusion license key here. Contact info@bfusion.eu for a license.

controlState.description: Set by the in-visual Analysis and Grain pickers and the insights panel's collapse control. Not meant to be edited here.

rowExpansion.description: Set by the in-visual expand/collapse chevrons. Not meant to be edited here.
